functions.name: jquery_core
functions.done: Returns the jQuery 3.6.0 dependency structure. Matches R exactly.

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(jquerylib))

result <- jquery_core()
invisible(result)
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  result <- jquery_core()
  elapsed[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
}
cat(sprintf("r_ms %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(unclass(result), auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null"), "\n")
proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import time

from jquerylib.jquery_core import jquery_core


result = jquery_core()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = jquery_core()
    elapsed.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
print(f"py_ms {statistics.median(elapsed) * 1000:.17g}")
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
